# Tokens

Both kits define the same token names. Pro maps its own scale (bg/fg/line ladder, status colours) onto Halo's names; where Pro had no equivalent the value is derived from its rules and written as a reference (`{bg-000}`). Themed values read `light / dark`. Halo follows the system theme by default, Pro is dark by default.
